alex_k: heads up — we just got a PV alert from billing: two customers reported being charged twice in the same minute. looks like retries + fanout to shards?
priya_r: ugh. any traces/ids?
mike_s: linked the sample request id in the alert: req=01FZ9... client sends Idempotency-Key: 7a2f. gateway logged a 202 from shard-A then retried to shard-B after a timeout. both shards committed.
taylor_o: so gateway retry logic doesn't funnel retries to the same metering owner. we were assuming idempotency keys live in local cache per-shard with TTL.
jen_l: to confirm: client used the same Idempotency-Key on retry?
mike_s: yes — header preserved. but because of race, shard-A accepted and recorded usage, shard-B didn't know about shard-A's acceptance. no cross-shard dedupe.
alex_k: quick sketch of the sequence: 1) request -> shard-A, 2) shard-A processes but response delayed by 180ms, 3) gateway times out at 100ms and routes retry -> shard-B, 4) shard-B succeeds and returns, gateway returns success, 5) shard-A finishes and also records metering. result: double-charge.
priya_r: logs: ```
2026-06-01T14:12:03Z gateway: routed req=01FZ9 -> shard-A
2026-06-01T14:12:03.100 gateway: retrying req=01FZ9 -> shard-B (timeout)
2026-06-01T14:12:03.180 shard-B: ACCEPT idempotency=7a2f charge=1
2026-06-01T14:12:03.280 shard-A: ACCEPT idempotency=7a2f charge=1
```
mike_s: and our meter backend currently treats each accept as an independent usage event.
taylor_o: do we have any existing cluster-wide dedupe? I thought metering-owner concept existed for some write paths.
jen_l: only for billing writes via the centralized metering service, but that service is async and receives writes from shards. shards also optimistically write local counters to ensure low-latency usage accounting. that's the problem.
alex_k: what are quick mitigations? Options: a) make gateway sticky per-idempotency to same shard (but traffic imbalances), b) have shards check central dedupe synchronously (latency hit), c) add short "commit marker" to central store before accepting, d) best-effort reconciliation job that refunds duplicates (post-facto).
priya_r: option (a) could be implemented quickly: hash(Idempotency-Key) -> preferred shard and retry routing uses that. Would avoid cross-shard retries. downside: hotspot risk for abusive keys.
mike_s: (c) sounds safer: shard writes a pre-commit record to central dedupe store with TTL; if write succeeds, continue. if central is slow, we stall and increase latency.
taylor_o: also we should stop local optimistic meter incrementing until we confirm dedupe ownership. temporary solution: mark local increments as provisional and garbage collect if central dedupe reports duplicate.
jen_l: can we detect double-charge from streaming metrics? e.g., two accepts with same idempotency within 1s across different shards => auto-flag and init refund path.
alex_k: yes — add a realtime rule in Console: if metering.events with same idempotency key count >1 within window W then fire incident-ticket plus automatic credit flow. low-latency detection is doable.
priya_r: client-side guidance too: increase retry timeout and exponential backoff. update docs in SDKs to recommend stronger retry/backoff and emphasize Idempotency-Key stability.
mike_s: proposing immediate action plan: 1) hotfix gateway to prefer sticky routing for retries using hash(Idempotency-Key) behind a feature flag (alex + taylor), 2) add a detection alert + dashboard tile in Console (jen), 3) design central pre-commit prototype for next sprint (mike + priya).
taylor_o: i'll own the gateway flag PR. quick note: need e2e test that simulates delayed ack from shard so we don't regress.
jen_l: console tile: show "potential double-charge" rate, sample request ids, and a one-click create refund task. Also include link to telemetry traces.
priya_r: will add SDK blurb. small config: make flag off by default for risky customers, enable gradually for orgs showing duplicates.
mike_s: risk: sticky routing means gateway must include consistent hash function across regions for multi-region failovers. added complexity. but ok for immediate rollout to single-region clusters.
alex_k: rollout plan: gate behind "retry-sticky-v1" ff; enable for 10% orgs tonight, monitor double-charge metric. if stable, widen.
jen_l: alert thresholds: >3 potential double-charges / hour for org => pager? otherwise log-only.
taylor_o: PR ready in a few hours. adding unit tests and a chaos test to simulate skew.
priya_r: I'll draft the console tile and the SDK note this afternoon.
mike_s: follow-up tasks: design central dedupe API (sync vs pre-commit), measure latencies, and estimate cost of central writes. put on next sprint planning.
alex_k: thanks team. deploy-bot: can you run canary for gateway after taylor's PR lands?
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: canary (10%) for service=gateway, tag=retry-sticky-v1. will run health checks and report in #eng-platform-deploys. :robot_face:
jen_l: leaving this thread with the action items captured in the ticket I created: INF-9823. adding owners and due dates. :thumbsup:
priya_r: thanks. let's also surface this in the rollout UX notes — we need a standard guide for retry semantics and metering ownership.
alex_k: agreed. closing thread after rollout completes.
